newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street eases off session low, NYSE lift curbs.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street eases off session low, NYSE lift curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chip shares recovered lost ground in afternoon trading on Tuesday as market-watchers tried to gauge whether or not the Federal Open Market Committee would raise short term rates today.
The New York stock exchange lifted curbs on index- arbitrage trading as Dow industrials clambered from a session low of 7153 to trade off around 30 points at 7198.

The Nasdaq composite, firm for much of the day, was up over six points at 1348. It was helped Intel Corp, which rose 3-3/4 at 158-1/2 after positive analyst comment about sales. The long bond also recovered from early lows.
